name: Chongqing Zhixin Industrial Co., Ltd
summary: Chongqing Zhixin Industrial Co., Ltd. engages in the development, processing, production, and sale of automotive stamping and welding parts in China and internationally. It offers cold stamped parts, such as front floor, high-voltage battery bottom guard plate, upper reinforcement of side panel outer plate, top cover, top mounting plate, lower reinforcement of front panel center channel, and B-pillar inner plate; and thermoformed parts, including door rings, lower box bottom guard plates, B-pillar reinforcement plates, anti-collision beams, front longitudinal beams, and upper and lower sections of A-pillar reinforcement plates, as well as other products.
